hooks.name: Auto Build APK SIGAP PKL
hooks.description: Otomatis trigger build APK di server setiap kali build.gradle disimpan

action.command: powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoProfile -Command "$key='$env:USERPROFILE\.ssh\sigap_pkl_key'; $scp='C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\scp.exe'; $ssh='C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\ssh.exe'; $srv='root@103.153.190.69'; $f=$env:KIRO_FILE_PATH; if(-not $f){exit 0}; & $scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -i $key $f ${srv}:/opt/sigap-build/android/app/build.gradle 2>&1; & $ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=120 -o ServerAliveInterval=20 -i $key $srv 'bash /tmp/server_build.sh > /tmp/build_log.txt 2>&1 &' 2>&1; Write-Host 'APK build dimulai di server background'"
